title: Moroccan Beef and Olive Tagine
meta_description: A slow-braised Moroccan beef and olive tagine with preserved lemon and saffron. Halal, deeply spiced, and built on classic braising technique.
og_title: Moroccan Beef & Olive Tagine | Halal Braised
og_description: Beef, olives, preserved lemon, and saffron braised until the sauce is thick and fragrant. A Moroccan tagine built on the same logic as a French braise — low heat, patience, fat.

image_briefs.prompt: Overhead shot of a deep clay tagine lid removed and resting to one side, revealing braised beef chunks in a glossy golden-yellow sauce with potato wedges, green olives, and strips of preserved lemon rind. Natural side light from a window. Rustic ceramic surface, no garnish yet added. Warm, earthy tones.
image_briefs.alt: Moroccan beef and olive tagine in a clay pot with preserved lemon and saffron sauce

image_briefs.prompt: Flat lay of raw ingredients on a pale linen surface: a pile of cubed halal beef, waxy potato wedges, a small dish of green olives, quartered preserved lemon halves showing yellow rind and soft flesh, small pinch bowl of saffron threads, and a jug of olive oil. Arranged with negative space between each item. No text.
image_briefs.alt: Ingredients for Moroccan beef olive tagine: beef, potatoes, olives, preserved lemon, saffron

image_briefs.prompt: Close-up shot inside a wide heavy-bottomed pot on a gas flame. Beef cubes and onion slices coated in turmeric and ginger are beginning to sizzle in olive oil, steam rising gently. The coating is yellow-gold and glistening. Slightly moody kitchen lighting. No human hands in frame.
image_briefs.alt: Beef and spices sweating in olive oil in a heavy pot — step one of tagine method

image_briefs.prompt: Shallow wide ceramic bowl, off-white, with a single generous serving of the beef tagine. Two pieces of beef, potato wedges, three olives, and a strip of preserved lemon visible in a reduced golden sauce. Scattered flat-leaf parsley. Beside the bowl, half a piece of Moroccan bread. Soft natural light. Shot at a 45-degree angle.
image_briefs.alt: Plated beef and olive tagine with preserved lemon and parsley in a white ceramic bowl
